title: $\pi_1$ of the plane minus $n$ points is free of rank $n$
author: @burkh4rt
source: Standard algebraic topology: the plane minus n points is homotopy equivalent to a wedge of n circles, whose fundamental group is free of rank n by the Seifert-van Kampen theorem. See Hatcher, Algebraic Topology, Example 1.21 and Corollary 1.21 (wedge of circles), and Forster, Lectures on Riemann Surfaces, section 4. Used as an input to the realization of finite groups over C(t) in Voelklein, Groups as Galois Groups, ch. 2, and Serre, Topics in Galois Theory, ch. 1
